source: Zhao et al. (1998), DOI 10.4131/jshpreview.7.25, Figures 2-4, pages 26-27
method: Manual tick/marker centre readings on the unmodified Figure 2 crop from a 450 dpi page-26 rendering; affine least-squares axis calibration. Coordinates are analysis pixels, not original experimental observations.

parity_assessment.basis: Five varied coefficients agree within their reported errors when the independently digitized Figure 2 pressure is used for row 15, with V0=438.67 A^3 and Tr=300 K fixed. This is published-model and parameter parity with a documented source-table error, rather than an exact recovery of the original numerical inputs and regression workflow.

row15.bound_convention: Conservative graphical reading bounds, not statistical experimental errors or fitted uncertainty.
row15.finding: Figure 2 places the matching marker near 4.6 GPa, while the Table 1 pressure would fall in an empty part of the plot. Supports a printed-table error; exact original pressure is not recovered.

ambient.finding: The plotted ambient point corroborates the printed volume column near 438.7 A^3; it does not recover the correct individual lattice dimensions.

figure2_curves.finding: All six curves have the expected ordering and agree within 0.3 A^3 at this graphical cross section. This supports graphical consistency, not numerical identity with the original plotting code. The labelled temperatures are 300, 473, 673, 873, 1073 and 1273 K; the caption's statement of 200 K steps above 300 K is inexact.

figure3.finding: Volume-temperature plot: raw points and pressure-corrected series are shown, but raw-point pressures are not encoded. It cannot independently determine row 15 pressure or recover the ambient lattice dimensions.

figure4.finding: The plotted zero-pressure mean expansivity near 3.82e-5 K^-1 is consistent with the adopted alpha(T) coefficients. Figure slope label -1.54(2)e-6 and prose -1.52(2)e-6 differ; this remains a separate secondary-regression discrepancy.

graphical_interpretation_diagnostic.selection: All 32 original rows; row 15 uses the Figure 2 pressure rounded to 4.58 GPa, exactly as in the separately bundled corrected P-V-T dataset. Original source tables and published coefficients are untouched.
graphical_interpretation_diagnostic.objective: Unweighted pressure residuals for sensitivity only; graphical bound is not an experimental row uncertainty.
